propositions: CLI write-command parsing uses hand-rolled loops with bespoke semantics (--assignee absent is None sentinel vs explicit empty-string clears; --force bare vs =reason forms differ by command) that should be replaced with argparse while preserving all observable behavior.

transition._parse_flags must be retained as a thin argparse-backed shim returning the identical 5-tuple (reason, force_reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) because three external tests import and call it directly with expectations on None-vs-empty-string and retired --force-close rejection.

argparse defaults must be overridden: add_help=False (help served by dispatcher from golden files), allow_abbrev=False (exact-token match only), parse_known_args (unknown tokens skipped silently), and custom error() override to exit 1 with historical messages instead of argparse's exit-2.

--force command-specific semantics must be preserved exactly: claim bare --force consumes following non-`--` token else '(no reason given)'; transition bare --force yields force_reason='' (None only absent) and does NOT consume following token, with observable force note '(no reason given)' via _force_note mapping.

--assignee must preserve None-vs-empty-string sentinel: absent defaults to default_assignee, explicit empty string clears assignee, value-less argument exits 1; both inline =value and space-separated forms accepted.
Complexity baseline entry for transition._parse_flags (now below threshold after argparse rewrite) must be drained from .github/complexity-baseline.json to keep test_complexity_baseline.py green.
